delivery.availability: All 2730 descendants of z8/133/90 and z8/133/91. No tiles outside, below z8 or above z13; not a global product.

encoding.description: R*256+G+B/256-32768 metres; nearest quantization; EGM2008 unchanged
encoding.name: terrarium

resampling.value: Finest bilinear source sampling; recursive box-mean parents; renderer overzoom above z13 only.

lineage.limitations: Complete immediate published dataset contributor; per-post upstream infill/epoch remains unavailable. Coarse averaging suppresses extrema; no structural generalisation.

processing.method: Mosaic six whole 2021 COGs preserving source Point registration; horizontal EPSG:4326 to EPSG:3857 bilinear warp to aligned z13 float32 heights. No height or registration adjustment.
Recursive 2x2 arithmetic means of unencoded heights; float64 accumulation and float32 storage. Uniform Mercator pixel area, not ground-area weighting.
Encode each level independently as lossless RGB PNG Terrarium; no encoded-RGB averaging.

product.name: Meridian bounded Copernicus common/coarse terrain product

nodata.value: strict support propagation, omit any incomplete tile; no zero/alpha/AWS padding

sourceInformation.description: One-arcsecond source posts (~21.5 m east/west and 30.9 m north/south near Riffelhorn); measurement resolution unknown. Delivery z13 (~13.28 m there) oversamples these posts.

informationCeiling.value: Source posts bound available information. z12 already undersamples the east/west postings locally; z13 avoids that but adds no observations. No sharp isotropic information zoom is claimed; all higher renderer zoom is overzoom.

transitionSupport.reason: No Swiss composition, transition or global ocean/polar policy established.

value.purpose: Bounded land-context delivery and preparation evaluation, not scientific ground truth or a validated regional seam

surface.description: Edited surface model including vegetation/buildings; water/hydrological editing and heterogeneous void filling. Not a bare-earth DTM.
